anatomical_prior.notes: Topology and homeostasis regularisers only. Hard anatomical constraints stay compiled; soft constraints update only within their priors (body.tex 6.4).

eegmmidb_real.notes: Scalp EEG during rest, real and imagined movement. Single site, single montage, no individual head models: supports population-level EEG prediction claims only.

montage_calibration.notes: Per-channel gain/offset/noise nuisance for the EEG head.

negative_control_shuffled.notes: Amplitude-matched, phase-randomised surrogates of the real EEG windows.

sim_wholebrain.notes: Delayed connectome-coupled neural-mass SDEs (Wilson-Cowan, Jansen-Rit, reduced Wong-Wang, Stuart-Landau, linear Gaussian) on a synthetic or agent-C connectome. Not participant data. Cannot establish biological validity.

sleepedf_real.notes: Two bipolar derivations (Fpz-Cz, Pz-Oz) at 100 Hz during sleep. Different state, different montage, different reference. Needs a source-specific adapter before it may update any shared operator.

tribe_v2_teacher.notes: Discrepancy-inflated interface regulariser only. Supplies no new neural observation, receives no authority over latent mechanisms, subcortical or bodily state, and cannot pull an individualized posterior toward an average brain.

schedule.note: sync points are exact in integer nanoseconds; a runtime that accumulates t += dt in floating point will drift against this plan
